title: The audit UI is the resident process, separate from each session's MCP server
trigger: Before restarting or killing the audit UI process, or when a server-side change must be picked up
behavior_delta: Treat the audit UI as the project's resident process (node src/cli.js ui, started by src/resident.js), not part of any session's MCP server: stopping it does not drop mcp__dd__* tools. A resident whose code changed reports stale: true on /api/status and is replaced at the next session start; to pick up a change now, run node src/cli.js ui, which retires the stale one.
what: Treat the audit UI as the project's resident process (node src/cli.js ui, started by src/resident.js), not part of any session's MCP server: stopping it does not drop mcp__dd__* tools. A resident whose code changed reports stale: true on /api/status and is replaced at the next session start; to pick up a change now, run node src/cli.js ui, which retires the stale one.
why: Since 2026-09-22 src/mcp/server.js no longer starts the UI in-process; it calls ensureResident. The previous version of this memory said killing the UI drops the MCP tools, which was true only of the old design.
